incidents-bot: [AUTOPAGER] pager: embeddings-service | error-rate spike > 5% (5xx)
count=123 errors in 5m · severity=P1 · routed to: Priya (oncall)
runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/embeddings-error-rate

Priya (oncall): ack — I'm paged, jumping in. tailing logs and metrics now.

Ethan (sre): I'm available to help. quick idea: check kvcache eviction churn + model routing fallback. Could be hot prefix causing high 5xx.

Priya (oncall): running query -> `kubectl logs -f deployment/embeddings --since=5m | grep ERROR | wc -l` shows 112 errors in last 5m, similar to pager. attaching small log sample:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z ERROR embeddings: kvcache miss for prefix abc123 size=0
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z ERROR embeddings: model runtime OOM when batch size=64
2026-03-15T09:12:07Z WARN  router: fallback triggered for route /v1/embed
```

Liam (eng-runtime): OOMs + fallback aligns with kernel selection thrash — maybe a quantized kernel regression. Can we temporarily route non-critical traffic to smaller model: `model-emb-small-v2`?

Priya (oncall): did the routing change to `model-emb-small-v2` for non-critical routes (done). Also reduced max_batch_size from 64 -> 32 for 10m window. Observing errors drop.

incidents-bot: mitigation applied: fallback routing ON · batch cap 32 · errors in last 2m down to 18 (from 123)

Ana (support): customer impact update: 8 customers opened support tickets (mostly elevated latency, 2 failed embedding uploads). Sent brief to accounts with ETA for postmortem. Keeping customers updated.

Maeve (product): thanks — proposal: classify as P1 => full postmortem + action items. We need to schedule postmortem within 48h and list owners + estimates.

Priya (oncall): agreed. preliminary action items with owners + rough sizing:
- INC-3419 investigate root cause & logs correlation · owner: Ethan (sre) · estimate: 3d
- INC-3420 adjust KV eviction policy & rollout test · owner: Liam (eng-runtime) · estimate: 5d
- INC-3421 add canary + automatic model fallback policy · owner: Liam + Priya · estimate: 3d
- INC-3422 alert tuning & reduce noisy SLO breaches · owner: Ethan · estimate: 1d
- INC-3423 customer comms template & follow-up · owner: Ana · estimate: 0.5d
- INC-3424 postmortem doc + timeline · owner: Maeve · estimate: 1d

Ethan (sre): add acceptance criteria for KV eviction change: no elevated eviction churn > 1% in 24h under load test · rollout gated by canary.

Maeve (product): prioritize: KV eviction fix (high, Q2 infra-ops), canary + fallback (med-high), alert tuning (low effort, high value) — we'll tie INC-3420 to Q2 sprint (flag with team tag).

Sam (oncall-next): taking handoff at 16:00 UTC. I'll monitor for 2h then run the smoke checklist and verify error-rate stays <1% for 30m.

Priya (oncall): handing off — summarized actions in the incident channel. Any objections to scheduling postmortem tomorrow 11:00 UTC? :spiral_calendar:

Maeve (product): 11:00 works, invite me + Ethan + Liam + Ana + Priya. add triage notes and attach logs.

incidents-bot: postmortem meeting scheduled: 2026-03-16T11:00Z · calendar invite created · doc: https://docs.internal/incidents/INC-3418-postmortem

Ethan (sre): quick log snippet showing reduced errors after mitigation:
```
2026-03-15T09:18:03Z INFO  embeddings: batch capped at 32, model fallback engaged
2026-03-15T09:19:10Z INFO  embeddings: errors=4 latency_p95=210ms
```

Maeve (product): next steps: create tickets with acceptance criteria, estimate in story points for planning, mark KV eviction as P0 for infra backlog. I'll add Q2 tag and circle with PMs.

Ana (support): I'll post customer follow-ups postmortem and keep accounts notified.

Priya (oncall): closing live mitigation. leaving monitoring handoff to Sam. I'll owner the postmortem coordination until Maeve spins up the doc. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. severity=P1 · postmortem required.
